subject: reasoning
question:
8 boys G, H, I, J, K, L, M and N are sitting around a square table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Four boys are sitting at the corner and four boys are sitting in the middle of the sides. J is the immediate neighbour of G and H and he is sitting at a corner. M is the immediate neighbour of N and K. L is the sitting in the middle of the side. G is not sitting opposite to L. N is towards the immediate right of H. 

Who is sitting diagonally opposite to I?
solution:
Given: 8 boys G, H, I, J, K, L, M and N are sitting around a square table facing towards the centre.

Four boys are sitting at the corner and four boys are sitting in the middle of the sides.

1) J is the immediate neighbour of G and H and he is sitting at a corner. 

2) N is towards the immediate right of H.
